About this Event

From Inner Fire to Grounded IntuitionAs we approach the transition from Scorpio season into the expansive energy of Sagittarius, we are invited to journey inward through an evening of Kundalini Yoga, meditation, and immersive sound healing. This gathering offers space to quiet the mind, deepen self-awareness, and reconnect with the intuition and inner wisdom that guide us toward greater clarity, trust, and grounded presence.
At the heart of this workshop is theBecome Intuitive Kriya, a set of Kundalini Yoga practices designed to refine awareness and strengthen our connection to intuitive intelligence. Through breathwork, movement, mantra, and meditation, we will explore the space beyond mental chatter, cultivating a deeper capacity to listen inwardly and recognize the subtle wisdom that emerges when we become still and present.
Astrologically, this gathering takes place in the final days of Scorpio season, a time traditionally associated with introspection, transformation, and the courage to look beneath the surface. With Mercury in Scorpio, we are invited to examine the thoughts, emotions, and patterns shaping our inner world, creating space for deeper understanding and discernment. Meanwhile, the Moon moves into Aries, bringing a complementary theme of initiative, courage, and forward movement. As we approach Sagittarius season, these energies offer an opportunity to transform inner insight into purposeful action, balancing reflection with the willingness to move forward in alignment with what feels true.
As movement gives way to stillness, the evening will conclude with an immersive sound journey, inviting you to soften, settle into spacious rest, and integrate the practice.
